summary: A copy button whose two sheets scale away while a check mark draws itself, then it reverts after 1.6 seconds.
use: Copy-to-clipboard buttons next to a command, token or link, where the icon confirms the action.
spec: `navigator.clipboard?.writeText(CODE)` on a real click; autoplay never touches the clipboard
`stroke-dasharray: 1;` with `stroke-dashoffset: 1` drawing to `stroke-dashoffset: 0` on the tick path
`announce('Copied to clipboard')` and a `ca-sr-only` label carry the state for screen readers
